Package frc.robot.commands.pathfind

Class Pathfind

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command

Direct Known Subclasses:
Pathfind.Supplied
public abstract class Pathfind extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SequentialCommandGroup
Abstract command for pose-based robot navigation using holonomic drive control.

This is an abstract command that subclasses override via Pathfind.Supplied or by implementing target().

Default concrete implementation: Pathfind.Supplied

  • Constructor Details

    • Pathfind

      public Pathfind(Drivetrain drivetrain)
      Constructs a Navigate command.
      1. Calls target() to get the target pose and caches it.
      2. Logs the target pose to the field for visualization.
      3. Runs Repulse for faraway pathfinding.
      4. Runs Nearby for close-range precision movement.
      5. Clears the target pose from the field logs.
      Parameters:
      drivetrain - Drivetrain subsystem for movement control

    • target

      protected abstract edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d target()
      Gets the target pose for this navigation.

      Subclasses must implement this to provide the target, which may be constant or dynamic (e.g., based on vision measurements).

      Returns:
      Target pose, or null if no valid target
